[[File:Arc_Emitter.png|thumb|The Arc Emitter]]
The '''Arc Emitter''' was a device build by [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] for the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The device was capable of disabling any equipment running off a generator, which posed a danger for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces. [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Fabel]] enlisted a Republic operative to steal an Anomid diagnostic pad and recalibrate it to make the Arc Emitter target itself in order to destroy it.
